facts: The Banco Central do Brasil states that Focus is published every Monday between 08:25 and 08:30.
The BCB states that historical series of all market-expectation statistics are available and that the same information is exposed through its Open Data portal.
Focus covers IPCA and Selic expectations required by the frozen two-component revision vector.
Official Focus publication pages expose the report reference date and publication date, supporting publication-to-publication ordering.
The report contains current-year IPCA and Selic median expectation statistics.
Official CVM daily fund reports include net asset value, subscriptions and redemptions.
Current and previous-month files are updated Monday through Saturday at 08:00 using documents received by CVMWeb through 23:59 of the prior day.
The dataset is openly downloadable and historical files are retained.
limitations: Portal availability can occasionally be delayed; the frozen rule therefore uses only data actually available before the target-session open and treats unavailable observations as ineligible.

facts: Official CVM delivery metadata records periodic and event-document deliveries and is updated daily for recent months, providing an auditable delivery layer for point-in-time eligibility.
Official fund/class registration data are updated through the CVM open-data repository.
The class registration schema includes Classificacao and Classificacao_Anbima fields, allowing a deterministic equity-fund eligibility filter without performance selection.
B3 states that its Dados de Mercado file includes foreign-investor movement information.
Publication is daily and foreign-investor participation/movement is updated D+2.
The page states that the statistics concern financial purchase and sale flows and publishes monthly, annual and prior-year accumulations.
limitations: The official public page inspected does not affirmatively document distinct machine-readable foreign-investor purchase-value and sale-value fields required by the frozen normalized feature.
A generic movement or net-flow field cannot substitute for the frozen purchase-minus-sale divided by purchase-plus-sale formula.

facts: Official B3 daily bulletins and historical market files support daily target-return and exchange-session reconstruction for the Focus and CVM-flow families.
